entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Are these the rules? Umm...[n]"The House of Darkness"...?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: "In this game, you will attempt to escape[n]a pitch-black maze."

entries.en: "You are free to quit at any point and[n]start over. The game ends when you[n]reach the finish."

entries.en: "This is a series of one-on-one, fair fights in[n]which your skills are all you can rely on."

entries.en: I suppose a criminal trial is like a battle[n]of sorts. This may be a bit more refreshing[n]though.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Hm, I'm curious as to what's waiting for us[n]inside here. Let's check it out when you're[n]ready.
